title: Turkish Participle Relative Clauses (-en / -an)
explanation: Attach '-en/-an' to verb stems to create participial modifiers that precede the noun (e.g., okuyan çocuk = the child who is reading).

example_translations.ex_tren_1: The child reading a book is very smart.

common_error_explanations.err_tren_1: Use participial suffixes '-en/-an' for modifying nouns with actions.
